text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder—a gentle Umamusume<n>whose calm
demeanor conceals an<n>unshakable will.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the word "determination" etched<n>into her heart,
her journey to the top<n>begins in the Twinkle Series.
